title: kate-ui: count visual rows for a wrap width
summary: visual_row_count splits one logical line into rows of a fixed column width. A width of 0 yields one row. This packet does not edit session.rs, paint.rs, keys.rs, or lib.rs. Linux CI runs the tests.

lane.reason: The function is in kate-ui and has no GPUI type in its signature. Linux CI runs the layout tests. It does not need a Mac or the owner's eyes. Do not compile session.rs for this packet.

data_contracts.schema_diff_summary: The function is pub(crate). It uses cfg_attr(not(test), allow(dead_code)), as layout.rs line 15 does. Count Unicode scalars. Each scalar has width 1. An empty line returns 1. A columns value of 0 returns 1. Otherwise return the smallest row count that holds the scalars, and at least 1. Do not call this from session.rs.
